cards.title: Useful agents need your company context
cards.summary: Brockman says his agent answers company questions and queries business metrics, giving his human chief of staff more leverage.
cards.interpretation: The integration layer may matter as much as the model: useful answers require access to the right records and definitions. This is a company insider’s anecdote, not a benchmark of accuracy or productivity.
cards.opportunity: Choose one internal metric with a known answer. On already authorized data, compare the agent’s query, sources and definitions with the existing analyst answer before broadening the workflow.
